_comment: Physical layout, in millimetres. diagram.json says what is connected; this file says where it physically sits. check_enclosure.js refuses to pass until every part has room, every port can see out, and every shell is closed.

parts._why: rot 180 puts the USB socket 0.6 mm from the BACK wall - the cable leaves away from the indicator; pulled right to leave the screw posts their corners
the one status light, looking out of the front wall at eye height
flat on the floor in front of the board

bosses._why: not the corners: the LED and the board own those, so the posts sit on the side walls
